name: Jain Scripture
translation: Selected passages (after Hermann Jacobi, Sacred Books of the East)
note: Selections from the foundational texts of Jainism, a tradition of radical nonviolence older than Buddhism. The Tattvartha Sutra (c. 2nd-5th century CE) condenses Jain doctrine into a single page; the Acaranga Sutra, the oldest Jain text, teaches ahimsa — nonviolence toward every living being.
